description: A painted industrial scene: a refinery of tall distillation towers, pipes and round storage tanks along a shore, with smoke rising from stacks. On the left a crowd of men in flat caps and suits presses against iron gates, several raising fists. On the right, men in long overcoats and fedoras walk along the waterfront carrying briefcases and suitcases. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
